title: docs.ai
tagline: Docs.AI transforms how you read, process, and act on documents. AI-powered agents summarize, translate, and verify contracts, invoices, and tax filings. Automate payments, approvals & compliance with smart contracts—seamless, secure & intelligent! 🔥📜
description:
Docs.ai is a next-generation AI-powered document automation & crypto payment platform that transforms static contracts into dynamic, self-executing agreements—think DocuSign meets Smart Contracts! 🎯

With AI agents, users can:
✅ Extract key insights from PDF contracts 📄
✅ Generate payment instructions automatically 💵
✅ Trigger on-chain payments when conditions are met 🔗
✅ Automate late fees & recurring charges 💳
✅ Integrate secure, crypto-native transactions with Coinbase Wallet  using Onchain Kit🦊

🔑 Key Features
📝 AI-Powered Document Parsing
Upload or select a contract 📄
AI reads & summarizes key terms 🤖
Detects payment conditions (amount, due date, penalties) ⏳
Provides an intelligent, human-readable summary 📊
💸 Smart Payment Execution
AI extracts the recipient's wallet address 🔗
Calculates payment amount + late fees automatically ⏳
Triggers crypto payments securely via MetaMask or Coinbase Wallet 🦊
Supports ETH & ERC-20 tokens 🚀
⚖️ Decentralized Enforcement
AI monitors contract conditions 📡
Sends reminders before due dates 📅
Auto-applies late fees if payment is delayed ❌
Ensures transparency & trust with on-chain transactions 🌍
🔄 Recurring & Conditional Payments
Supports subscription models & installment payments 🔄
Store payment details securely for future transactions 🔐
Refund & dispute resolution AI 🤖

💡 Example Use Cases
1️⃣ Tax Filings & CA-Approved Documents – AI verifies compliance and automates crypto tax payments.
2️⃣Invoice & Payment Requests – AI extracts invoice details and triggers on-chain payments.
3️⃣Legal & Business Contracts – Smart contracts auto-execute terms and monitor compliance.
4️⃣Loan & Mortgage Agreements – AI calculates interest, due dates, and automates repayments.
5️⃣ Salary & Employment Contracts – Payroll processing with AI-driven crypto disbursements.
6️⃣Insurance Claims & Settlements – AI verifies claims and automates policyholder payouts.
7️⃣Intellectual Property & Copyright Licensing – Smart contracts manage royalty payments and IP transfers.
how_its_made:
Docs.AI is built using the Onchain AI Agent Kit, Autonome, and AI-powered automation, combining the best of Ethereum, smart contracts, and decentralized AI agents. The system architecture leverages the following technologies:

- 🌐 Frontend: Built with Next.js for a fast, responsive, and SEO-friendly user interface, styled using Tailwind CSS for a sleek and modern design.
- ⚙️ Backend: Powered by Node.js with Express, ensuring a scalable and efficient server-side application.
- 🤖 AI Framework: Integrated with Autonome, enabling seamless deployment and management of decentralized AI agents for automated tasks and workflows.
- 🐳 Containerization: Docker is used for setting up and managing the Autonome framework, ensuring consistency across environments and simplifying deployment.
- 🔗 Blockchain Integration: Utilizes Ethereum and smart contracts to ensure secure, transparent, and decentralized operations of AI agents.
